documents_expected.why: call page with the Local Impact guidelines
application form (script-rendered; its questions may hold more requirements)

eligibility.rule: US: a municipality, public institution or IRS 501(c) organisation
eligibility.quote: Organization Eligibility U.S: Must be a municipality, public institution, or registered with the IRS as a 501(c)(3) or other 501(c) determination.

eligibility.rule: Canada: a provincially registered nonprofit, municipality, public institution or CRA charity
eligibility.quote: Organization Eligibility Canada: Must be a provincially registered nonprofit, municipality, public institution, or an organization registered as having charitable status by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).

eligibility.rule: A specific project, programme or event on wildlife and habitat or new audiences outdoors
eligibility.quote: Request must be for a specific project, program, or community event that is focused on one of our key conservation pillars of Conserving Wildlife and Habitat or Connecting New Audiences to the Outdoors.

eligibility.rule: Not events, operating support, capital, construction, early-phase projects or vehicles
eligibility.quote: The Outdoor Fund does not support fundraising events, banquets, and/or items to be given away to participants, general operating support, capital campaigns or endowments, construction and building costs, projects that are in the design or development phase, ATV/UTV and boat requests.

eligibility.rule: Engages communities near a Bass Pro or Cabela's store
eligibility.quote: Supporting local organizations and projects that engage communities near our retail locations

notes: Funds must be used within one calendar year (not a tracked duty). The Apply Now links go to Benevity forms that render with scripts; the gathered text cannot show their questions, so the stamp must not be set from this page alone.
